scope: ADR-006 organization sign-in handles issued by APP-009 for the two fixture organizations. Non-secret routing: each appears in the sign-in URL and in the fAuth client's return_entry_url; it grants nothing. Only its forma:signin-handle:v1 digest is stored, in genui_private.handle_index.
generated: 2026-10-29, 16 bytes each from the operating system CSPRNG (Python secrets), canonical lowercase RFC 4648 base32 without padding
install: app/runtime/admission_operator.py issue-handle --organization <organization> --handle <handle> (operator channel, D7.19); the local session campaign installs exactly these values
not_done_here: No managed (RDS) database has these handles; APP-077/078 install them there with the same command, and FormaStack registers each return_entry_url. Rotation: rotate-handle, re-register, then retire-handle.
